description: wakewordlab 'hey jarvis' followed by a speaker-verification gate: an activation only counts when the verifier confirms it. The plugin's own built-in VAD gate is disabled (vad:false) for this fighter.
notes: Combo fighter: wake-word engine + verifier. The plugin's own config.hotwords.hey_jarvis.vad is set to false here so the verifier is isolated from the built-in VAD gate; compare against the bare wakewordlab-hey-jarvis fighter (built-in VAD on, no verifier).
